title: docs(skills,spec): the fieldPatches example patches options only on a field that declares them, so HotCRM accepts it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xMHYuqFd4hLYHNf14Fg8wBe)_

Fixes #30944

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review model tier for `skills/**` (clause ①). The maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03) waives it; this PR was developed below that tier, and the dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`fieldPatches` 的唯一示例改为只改 `industry` 的 `label`,选项补丁移到自带 inline `options` 的 `type`(`customer` → `Client`);覆盖 `objectstack-data` 技能、spec 的 `fieldPatchesDescription()` 与 TSDoc、`object-extensions.mdx`,`references/data/object.mdx` 由 spec 重新生成。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 的 `crm_account.industry` 绑定共享 picklist `industry`,`fieldPatchTargetMisses` 对其任何 `options` 键返回 `picklist-option`,照抄旧示例会在安装和 `os validate` 时被拒。
- 风险与回滚:只改说明文字和示例,无 schema、键或行为变化;发布 `@objectstack/skills` 与 `@objectstack/spec` 各一个 patch;回滚即 revert。
- Token 账:SKILL.md 示例多 10 字节,删掉同文件 `.custom` 段末重复的 "a base field changes only through `fieldPatches`" 付账;上限行不动(6068/6078)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L364 与 `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `fieldPatchesDescription()`。
- 需要你做的:无;席位负责复审与落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L364: the example is now `defineObjectExtension({ extend: 'crm_account', fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector' }, type: { options: { customer: { label: 'Client' } } } } })`. `extend: 'crm_account'` and `label: 'Sector'` stay whole tokens (eval cases 5 and 7 of `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` require them). The sentence before it still states that "a `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable".
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, description text only: `fieldPatchesDescription()` now says an option of a field bound to a shared `picklist` is never patchable and only a field declaring its own `options` takes an option patch, and its example sets `industry`'s `label` and `inlineHelpText` and patches `type`'s `customer` option. The `ObjectExtensionSchema` TSDoc example carries the same patch; since that example extends `contact`, its comment is conditional: where `industry` is picklist-bound, as on HotCRM's `crm_account`, its options are not patchable (its display keys are). No schema change.
- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`: regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs` after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`; not hand-edited.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` L104-118: the `os:check` example drops `industry`'s `options` (a comment says it takes them from a shared picklist) and patches `type: { options: { customer: { label: 'Client' } } }`. Its existing bullet on picklist-bound fields (L152-153) now agrees with the example.
- Two changesets: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` and `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, each with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. No `skip-changeset`.

Read on HotCRM `main` at `6961ab1`, `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts`:

- L311-318: `industry: Field.select({ label: 'Industry', group: 'basic', picklist: 'industry' })`, no inline `options` (the values, `technology` among them, live in `src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts` L23).
- L300-309: `type: Field.select({ label: 'Account Type', …, options: [...] })` declares its own inline options; L305 is `{ label: 'Customer', value: 'customer', … }`, so `customer` is a stored value the patch can address.

Read on objectstack `main`: `fieldPatchTargetMisses` in `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts` pushes `reason: 'picklist-option'` for every key under a patch's `options` when the target field has a non-empty `picklist`, before it looks at option values; a field with inline `options` is checked by stored value (`reason: 'option'` when absent). The new examples pass both checks.

Out of scope and left as is: the `options` shape error message in `object.zod.ts` (`'options: { technology: { label: \'Tech\' } }'`, near L5034) illustrates the map shape, not a HotCRM patch.

**Token ratchet.** `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`: after merging `main` at `acd190b2` the ceiling is 6078 with 1 byte of slack. The new example adds 10 bytes. Payment, by the seat's ruling: the `.custom` paragraph's closing clause "; a base field changes only through `fieldPatches`" (L372 on `acd190b2`) is deleted. Its home is L355-360 of the same file: "**Relabel a field the owner declares with `fieldPatches` — never by redeclaring it in `fields`**" and "the type, values and rules stay the owner's". The file is now 6068 tokens (ceiling 6078, headroom 10). No ratchet row moves, nothing was re-wrapped. Net lines in `skills/**`: 0.

## Why

The one concrete `fieldPatches` example the platform taught, in the skill, the spec description and two docs pages, patched an option of HotCRM's picklist-bound `industry`. A verbatim copy was refused at install and by `os validate`, and the skill paragraph contradicted its own rule.

## Verification

Head `5a6e8fad`: the two edit commits, a merge of `origin/main` at `acd190b2` (`8920b06e`, no conflict, no rebase), the ratchet-payment commit, and one commit for the contract review's two should-fixes (TSDoc comment made conditional; a skills-changeset claim the skill text does not make, dropped), and one commit for the delta review's must-fix (the comment said only the label was patchable; a picklist binding blocks only option patches).

<details><summary>Local gates on 7c661dec (head 5a6e8fad changes one TSDoc comment only): 105 derived, 105 run with exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED (`dispatch-gates --ran`)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 105 commands for the 6 changed files. All ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, a full `pnpm build` of the merged tree and a `@objectstack/spec` rebuild on this head (each exit 0), each under a 900 s timeout with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` and its exit code captured before any pipe. The larger heap is for this container: at the script's default 4096 MB, `check:test-typecheck` inside `check:generated` had tsc exit with no diagnostics; at 10240 MB it was green.
- All 105 exited 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check:generated`, `check:docs`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`. Also run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec tsc --noEmit` (exit 0) and `pnpm exec eslint packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (exit 0).
- `--ran` printed: `105 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 105 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- The first head `ad4d96f6` (before the merge) also ran all 105 with exit 0; there `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit, and exited 0 after fetching it.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0 (6 commits) before each push. Heads `22db7aee` and `7c661dec` ran all 105 with exit 0; `5a6e8fad` changes only those two TSDoc comment lines, and on it `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and `check:generated` exit 0 with nothing stale.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Description text only.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No names added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. `eslint` on the touched TypeScript file exits 0.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (`main` merged in, no rebase.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (`check:generated` exit 0).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is Chinese, per the lane template.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
